Chapter 7042: Feeling Better?

Chapter 7042: Feeling Better?

The dao court of Dusk Realm was highly coveted, containing Dusk’s dao mysteries and fortunes.

This was akin to obtaining Dusk’s cultivation. Some primordial immortals believed this could help them reach the shore or at the very least, control Dusk’s grand dao.

This meant they could unleash Dusk’s apex power - High Heaven’s Dusk. This should be infinitely close to being unbeatable.

While others searched for the dao court, Li Qiye found it in the blink of an eye. Within was boundless space filled with dao laws and mysteries.

These dao laws manifested into galaxies and stars. When one was in charge of this dao court, they were no different than the high heaven in its domain. Of course, they needed to be strong enough to grasp it.

At the center of the dao court was the purest of the grand dao in the form of a peerless lotus. A peerless woman dressed in white sat within the lotus; her beauty couldn’t be described with words.

Her cold aura engulfed the area, telling others that she was the master of this dao court. Dao chains made from the light of fortune protected her and connected her to the fortune lotus.

Thus, she immediately sensed Li Qiye’s intrusion and gazed upon him with the power of a celestial immortal.

“Boom!” She waved, unleashing a river of time and countless dao in his direction.

He smiled and let the dao smash and send him flying. The dao didn’t stop and pressed down on his chest.

It turned into a spear, capable of piercing the high heaven and a major world.

“Die!” As the spear thrust against his chest, she conjured a sword made from immemorial laws for another merciless slash.

Alas, both couldn’t hurt him. She didn’t stop and unleashed a variety of moves - bolts from the high heaven, incredible flames, and poison...

“Rumble!” Dimensions shattered during the onslaught.

After a long while, she became tired, unable to kill him. He landed before her and smiled: “Feeling better?”

“Only when you’re dead.” Despite her sharp tone, her gaze became noticeably softer.

“It’s difficult to kill the current me.” He smiled.

“If not today, then tomorrow.” She punched but he grabbed her fist tightly.

“Arrogant now that you’re a true immortal?” She uttered coldly.

“Still so disobedient.” He smiled and pulled the woman into his arms, lowering his head to kiss her fragrant lips.
